Nora: quick async check-in — what I did yesterday: updated .NET quickstart with Windows dev steps, added M1 wheel note to mac installs, and fixed the sample-app README link. shipped https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/1245 :tada:
Sam: nice! saw the PR, left one nits comment about the config example. can follow up later today.
Nora: thanks — main blocker is sampleapp CI flake on python3.11 linting, looks like black/ruff ordering mismatch. failing command in CI:```bash
pytest tests/sample_app/test_endpoints.py -q
# error: E999: syntax error in test_utils.py: L72
```
Priya: I can take a look at the lint issue after standup. likely ruff config mismatch after the formatter upgrade. if it's easy I'll bump the config and push.
Tom: FYI I'm holding off on cutting the node-esm release until the sampleapp PR merges (we reference the sample in the docs). trying to avoid docs drift. planning to run a local smoke on Node 18 later.
Mika: quick question — are there any docs strings that need new screenshots after Nora's README fixes? I can update screenshots if someone points to the exact pages.
Nora: only one screenshot on /quickstarts/sample-app that shows the old CLI flags. I'll paste the URL in a sec. also @Sam please ignore the pip extras note in the PR; I'll remove it if it confuses the install flow.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs live preview build queued — preview URL will be posted to the thread when ready. (build 4821) :gear:
Sam: reply re: CI — I saw the ruff upgrade earlier. try adding `--extend-ignore E999` is a bandaid but better to fix the syntax. if Priya wants, I can pair on it for 15m.
Priya: pairing sounds good, ping me when you're free. I'll also open a tiny PR to align ruff configs across sdks repo.
Nora: plan for today: 1) pair with Sam/Priya on lint (blocker) 2) merge quickstart fixes 3) update screenshots if Mika needs them 4) follow up on two doc review comments. will post when I merge or if blocked further. :rocket:
